tagline.en_US: PPSSPP is a free and open-source PSP emulator for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Nintendo Wii U, Nintendo Switch, BlackBerry 10, MeeGo, Pandora, Xbox Series and Symbian with a focus on speed and portability.

description.en_US: PPSSPP is a free and open-source PlayStation Portable emulator designed with a focus on speed and portability. It allows users to run PSP games and homebrew software on modern systems. When accessed through a browser, it streams the emulator desktop interface, enabling remote gameplay with support for audio, file transfers, and gamepads.

tips: By default there is no authentication configured.
